subject: Harbor3b elevated 5xx/timeouts — initial report and status
messages:
From: Devon Patel <devon@atlaslytics.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: sre@atlaslytics.com
Date: 2028-06-03T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Harbor3b elevated 5xx observed in production — urgent

Hi Rafael,

We started seeing a spike in 5xx responses from Harbor3b (production cluster us-west-2) beginning ~07:30 PDT this morning. The errors are mostly 502/504 and some timeouts; latency also increased for short requests.

Impact: several API endpoints for our conversational product returning errors; client retries have not recovered traffic. Rough estimate ~8% error rate on generation calls.

Can you confirm if there's an ongoing incident on your side? We rely on Harbor3b for a critical path and are seeing customer impact. Attaching a short sample of request IDs in the thread will follow.

Thanks — please advise ETA and any mitigation steps.

—Devon
Devon Patel
Head of Platform, Atlaslytics
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: Devon Patel <devon@atlaslytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-03T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Harbor3b elevated 5xx observed in production — urgent

Hi Devon — thanks for the report and the heads-up. We're looking into this as a priority.

Immediate actions I have kicked off:
- Opened an internal ops ticket (JIRA SUP-98127) and paged the runtime team.
- Asked for request-level logs and node health for your cluster; will push any short-term mitigations (fallback routing to compatible variant) if safe.

Can you share a few representative request IDs and the approximate timestamps (07:20–07:40 PDT)? That will speed correlation.

We’ll update you within 30 minutes with initial findings and a mitigation plan. Apologies for the disruption — we’ll treat this as an elevated incident.

Sincerely,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-03T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Harbor3b elevated 5xx observed in production — urgent

Rafael/Hannah — I’m on it. I’ve assigned SUP-98127 to runtime/serving and flagged as P1. First triage shows elevated kernel timeouts on the quantized execution path (Harbor3b-ptq) for a subset of instances in us-west-2.

Quick mitigation options discussed with infra:
- Immediate: route traffic away from affected instances to healthy pools (safe, brief interruption).
- Short-term: roll traffic to Harbor3b-ptq-compat variant with slightly higher memory but known stability.
- Investigation: capture kv-cache state + full runtime logs for faulty nodes.

I’ll push routing change now and update after logs are collected.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: Devon Patel <devon@atlaslytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-03T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Harbor3b elevated 5xx — interim mitigation applied

Hi Devon — quick update:

Thanks for the sample request IDs; they correlated to the node set we identified. We’ve taken the following steps:
- Routed your traffic off the 6 affected instances in us-west-2; traffic now flows to healthy pools.
- Enabled fallback to Harbor3b-ptq-compat for your account which trades a small memory overhead for stability.
- Collected runtime logs and kv-cache snapshots from affected nodes (attached).

Expected immediate impact: significant reduction in 5xx and timeouts within the next 5–10 minutes as connections drain. If you still see errors after 10–15 minutes, please send any new request IDs.

We will conduct a post-incident RCA and share the draft by EOD. Apologies for the disruption; we’ll include corrective actions and timeline for a more durable fix.

Attachments: harbor3b-runtime-logs-20280603.zip (log excerpts, node metrics)

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Devon Patel <devon@atlaslytics.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com

Thanks Rafael — appreciate the quick action and the log bundle. We see error rate dropping now (reports from our telemetry show errors down to ~0.7% at 09:15 PDT).

Two follow-ups from our side:
- Can you confirm whether this will count toward SLA credits, or do you need more time/data?
- We’d like a short postmortem for our audit records with timelines and mitigation steps.

If you need anything else from our logs we’ll share.

—Devon
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-06T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Harbor3b incident (2028-06-03) — RCA draft and action items

Team — closing note and next steps for the Atlaslytics incident on 2028-06-03. Posting summary here for tracking and customer follow-up.

Summary (RCA draft):
- Root cause: a regression in a kernel selector optimization for the ptq execution path that caused a subset of instances to fail when processing certain short-sequence requests; failure mode was elevated runtime timeouts and 502/504 responses.
- Timeline:
  * 07:30 PDT — first elevated 5xx observed (customer telemetry).
  * 07:40 — SUP-98127 created and runtime team paged.
  * 08:00 — initial triage: affected node subset identified in us-west-2.
  * 08:15 — routing change applied; fallback to Harbor3b-ptq-compat enabled for Atlaslytics.
  * 09:00 — observed error rate reduced to baseline.

Corrective actions (owners & ETA):
- Fix kernel selector regression in runtime (owner: runtime team) — PR targeted in next 48 hours; patch release and canary during off-peak window.
- Add additional unit/regression test for short-sequence ptq edge case (owner: infra-qe) — 7 days.
- Enhance automated health checks to detect this failure mode earlier (owner: serving-observability) — 14 days.
- Share customer-facing postmortem and SLA credit assessment (owner: Customer Ops / Legal) — deliver by 2028-06-07 EOD.

Attachments: harbor3b-postmortem-draft-20280606.docx (internal draft)
Related: JIRA SUP-98127, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-harbor3b-postmortem

Please review the draft and action items; I’ll send the customer-facing postmortem and SLA assessment tomorrow morning after Legal confirms wording.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
